method: weight jitter ±0.05 (renorm) 500 trials; param pool 12 worlds conservative vs idle (12m proxy)

interpretation: Measured sensitivity Exceeds fragility threshold. Do not claim stable ranking on cash alone. Full CoreScore with P/E/O (see audit) shows dispersion; weight sensitivity disclosed per §36.5 rather than hidden.
uncertainty_vs_sampling: More seeds (10→20) halve sampling CI but do not fix model misspecification; tail power events remain labeled hard-to-calibrate.
action: Freeze anchors v1.0 as-is with sensitivity warning; require ≥24 pilot worlds and full P/E/O scoring for ranked leaderboard (spec §30.2 power analysis).
